name: .224 Cal-51gr Absolute Hammer™

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist is 1-9.75″ or faster

note: Recommended use: small to medium big game hunting. The product page also says: "This mid to light weight Absolute Hammer™ is going to be very quick. From varmints to medium game the impact velocities from this bullet are going to be devastating under 300y. The Absolute Hammer™s do not line up with conventional bullet load data and should only be loaded by experienced hand loaders that are comfortable reading pressure and figuring out a load without supporting data to work from."
